about: What the MEDS_extract-CDSL runner (CDSL_MEDS 2f08708, MEDS-Extract 0.8.0) built from the synthetic release of tests/conftest.py with --no-enrich: each code's description and number of events. tests/test_runner_equivalence.py checks that meds-extract-run spec=CDSL still builds it.

AGE_AT_ADMISSION.description: Patient age, placed at hospital admission; numeric_value is the age (CDSL patient_01.age)

EMERGENCY_DEPARTMENT//1.description: Emergency department visit; department where the patient was treated: 1 (CDSL patient_01.department_emerg)

EMERGENCY_DEPARTMENT_VISIT.description: Emergency department visit that led to the hospital admission (CDSL patient_01.admission_date_emerg, time_admission_emerg)

EMERGENCY_DIAGNOSIS//1.description: Diagnosis given in the emergency department: 1 (CDSL patient_01.diag_emerg)

HOSPITAL_DISCHARGE//X.description: Hospital discharge; discharge destination: X (CDSL patient_01.destin_discharge)

INPATIENT_DIAGNOSIS//X.description: COVID-related diagnosis of the hospital admission: X (CDSL patient_01.diag_inpat)

LAB//X//X.description: Laboratory test: X; unit: X (CDSL lab_06.item_lab, lab_06.ud_result)

MECHANICAL_VENTILATION.description: Mechanical ventilation during the hospital stay (CDSL patient_01.mechvent is Yes); placed at hospital admission, not at the start of ventilation

MEDICATION_END//ATC5//H03AA//ATC7//H03AA.description: End of medication: LEVOTIROXINA SÓDICA (CDSL atc7.atc7_name)

NEOPLASM_ICDO3//8140/3.description: Neoplasm, ICD-O-3 morphology code 8140/3 (CDSL diagnosis_hosp_03 neo_* columns)

VITAL//BLOOD_GLUCOSE.description: Blood glucose level; unit not documented (CDSL vital_signs_04.glu_ing, patient_01.glu_first_emerg, glu_last_emerg)

VITAL//DIASTOLIC_BLOOD_PRESSURE.description: Diastolic (minimum) blood pressure; unit not documented (CDSL vital_signs_04.bp_min_ing, patient_01.bp_min_first_emerg, bp_min_last_emerg)

VITAL//HEART_RATE.description: Heart rate; unit not documented (CDSL vital_signs_04.hr_ing, patient_01.hr_first_emerg, hr_last_emerg)

VITAL//OXYGEN_SATURATION.description: Oxygen saturation; unit not documented (CDSL vital_signs_04.sat_02_ing, patient_01.sat_02_first_emerg, sat_02_last_emerg)

VITAL//SYSTOLIC_BLOOD_PRESSURE.description: Systolic (maximum) blood pressure; unit not documented (CDSL vital_signs_04.bp_max_ing, patient_01.bp_max_first_emerg, bp_max_last_emerg)

VITAL//TEMPERATURE.description: Body temperature; unit not documented (CDSL vital_signs_04.temp_ing, patient_01.temp_first_emerg, temp_last_emerg)

VITAL//URINE_OUTPUT.description: Urine output (diuresis) at the first emergency department assessment; unit not documented (CDSL patient_01.diuresis_first_emerg)
